comment.body:
Thanks for reporting that Peek stops working after the laptop has been idle and starts working again after opening PowerToys. To identify which activation path is failing, please provide:

1. After the next failure, confirm whether the configured Peek shortcut, Explorer preview, or both fail, and whether the laptop was locked or resumed from sleep.
2. Reproduce the failure and immediately comment `/bugreport`, then attach the generated ZIP. If the normal PowerToys UI cannot open, use the installed `BugReportTool.exe` fallback.
3. Include the Windows version/build from `winver`.

This will distinguish a stopped Peek process from a shortcut or Explorer-integration failure.
